purpose: Make the frozen Legacy record-before-termination boundary executable while keeping free-text reason and Legacy runtime surfaces outside the preserved fact.

provenance.notes: An external C++17 harness was compiled against a clean frozen extraction with w64devkit GCC 16.2.0 and run twice. During termination evaluation it reads the flushed t0 CSV row; the main build consumes only pinned captures and an independent probe with no Legacy dependency.

expected_facts.claim: The t0 stopping state is recorded and visible before termination evaluation returns true, and the run completes at the same boundary.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Event identity, order, multiplicity, step and row count are exact; the frozen scalar seed uses absolute tolerance 1e-12.

expected_facts.claim: A predicate satisfied at t0 yields one t0 row, final time t0 and no later observation.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Dataset row count and final time are exact at the fixture boundary.

expected_facts.claim: The observation is tied to the frozen archive, Simulator, logger, sink, termination interface, runtime test, harness, environment and raw capture identities.
expected_facts.tolerance_policy: Paths, byte counts, line-ending reconstruction and SHA-256 values are exact.

acceptance: Verifies frozen source, environment, harness, runtime-test, stored artifacts and reconstructed raw CSV identities
Two Legacy datasets are byte-identical and two traces normalize to one semantic timeline
The Legacy evaluator observes the flushed t0 row before returning true
Independent Decimal/Python and C++17 checks agree on the stopping state, event order and final time
Termination-before-record, row-not-visible-at-evaluation, missing terminal row and post-stop advance are rejected independently
Changing Legacy free-text reason leaves semantic comparison unchanged
Preserve and Retire recommendations remain pending until the repository owner accepts the disposition choice
